suṭṭhapita: [ su + ṭhā + ṇāpe + ta. Thapa + ta. Su + sthāpitaka-sakkatapiṭaka. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Well stopped. (2) Well placed or established.
suṭṭhapitacitta: [ suṭṭhapita + citta ] (ti) CL=7 The mind that should be well-established and firmly settled.
suṭṭhapitadvāravātapāna: [ suṭṭhapita + dvāravātapāna ] (ti) CL=7 The entrance door, the exit door, and the window should be well-closed.
suṭṭhita: [ su + ṭhā + ta. Susthita-saṃ. Suṭṭhi a-prā, suṭṭhiya-addhamāgadhī. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Well-establishing (unshakable). (2) Well-steady.
suṭṭhu: [ su + ṭhā + u (ṇu). Ṭhā gatinivattiyaṃ, supubbo, ṭhāti pavattati sundarabhāvenāti suṭṭhu. Sobhanaṃ (sobhaṇaṃ-saṅa့). Ṇvādi. 6. Su tiṭṭhatīti suṭṭhu, pasaṃsā, atisayaṃ. Kappadduma. Pāṇinī, uṇādi. 1. 52. Sādhu suṭṭhu iccete sampaṭicchanānumodanatthesu. Nīti, sutta. 387. Rū. 135. Suၑṭha-saṃ. Suṭṭhu suṭṭhuṃ-prā. (ti) suṭṭhu-addhamāgadhī. ] (bya) CL=7 (1) (a) Well. (B) Especially. (C) Respectfully. (2) Very. Extremely. (3) Most certainly. (4) Appreciation or blessing (anumodana, pasaṃsā). (5) Accepting or agreeing (Sampaṭicchana).
suṭṭhubalava: [ suṭṭhu + balava ] (ti) CL=7 A very strong person.
suṭṭhubhāva: [ suṭṭhu + bhāva ] (pu) CL=7 (1) A state of agreement on the speech. (2) Well-developed.
suṭṭhudaḷhabhāva: [ suṭṭhu + daḷha + bhāva ] (pu) CL=7 The extremely firm condition or state.
suṭṭhujātarohitavaṇṇa: [ suṭṭhu + jāta + rohita + vaṇṇa ] (ti) CL=7 The reddish appearance arises well.
suṭṭhukataparikamma: [ suṭṭhukata + parikamma ] (ti) CL=7 well-performed preliminary practice.
suṭṭhukicchavuttika: [ suṭṭhu + kiccha + vutti + ka ] (ti) CL=7 An extremely difficult livelihood.
suṭṭhusaṅgahitaantojana: [ suṭṭhu + saṅgahita + antojana ] (pu) CL=7 One should support close relatives (such as son, wife, servant, etc.) well.
suṭṭhutaraṃ: [ suṭṭhu + tara + aṃ. Suၑṭhutarama-saṃ. ] (bya) CL=7 (1) Better than. (2) Extremely. Excessively. (3) More right than.
suṭṭhuvilaggitatanumajjha: [ suṭṭhu + vilaggita + tanu + majcya ] (ti) CL=7 Possessing a beautiful, narrow waist.
suṭṭhutara: [ suṭṭhu + tara + aṃ. Suၑṭhutarama-saṃ. ] (bya) CL=7 (1) Better than. (2) Extremely. Excessively. (3) More right than.
